learnings: Tool errors (API failures, empty responses) should not cause 'inconclusive' package verdicts when other files are safe and one model completed a full audit successfully
The audit system should distinguish between 'file audit failed due to tool error' and 'file contains suspicious content' - tool errors should be retried or noted separately from security verdicts

When a package has only 4 small files and one model successfully audits all of them finding no issues, while other models' failures are clearly infrastructure-related, the verdict should be 'safe' rather than 'inconclusive'
